name: Goat Tech
description: Goat.Tech is a decentralized application designed to establish a reliable on-chain reputation standard through a gamified staking system. The platform allows users to stake ETH in each other' "trust pools," effectively building and measuring trust in a manner that reflects real-life interactions. By introducing a Trust Score, Goat.Tech provides a transparent metric for users to assess the reputation of others, which can lead to various benefits such as airdrops and investment opportunities. The application consists of two phases: the Goat Dapp, which gamifies reputation building, and Goat L2, a Layer 2 solution that maximizes ETH yields while enhancing users'reputations. Overall, Goat.Tech aims to create a trustworthy environment in the crypto space, transforming reputation into a valuable currency.
